svg.title: Systems engineering, software, and security
svg.desc: Systems software engineer focused on backend services, cloud infrastructure, and mobile applications. Interested in distributed systems, low-latency media and control, concurrent event processing, blockchain, and parallel state-space search. Native clients, backend services, and the protocols between them: scheduling, message ordering, backpressure, and idempotency under load. Embedded systems, control interfaces, and live video/telemetry relays with custom input handling. Network infrastructure, VPNs, secure tunnels, self-hosted services, and agentic systems. Research interests: Windows internals and APIs, browser sandbox escapes, firmware reversing, and code-execution chains. Authentication and WAF bypasses, parser differentials, protocol abuse, and automated reconnaissance. Cloud IAM misconfigurations, authorization bypasses, and cross-tenant isolation. Software supply-chain security: package-manager execution-policy bypasses and CI/CD credential exposure. Tools: Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, ffuf, Nuclei, Ghidra, WinDbg. Stack: Rust / Tokio · Go / Gin; Elixir / Phoenix / OTP; C++23 / Win32 / D3D11; Python / FastAPI; React · Next.js · TypeScript; React Native · Flutter · Expo; Broadway · RabbitMQ · AMQP; Media transport · IPC · RPC; SQL · NoSQL · vector stores; Linux · Docker · VMware; Nginx · AWS / GCP; VPNs · Overlay Networks; MCP · ONNX. 803 contributions, current streak 1 days, longest streak 9 days.
